title: Holiday Calendar
description: Provides information about public, school, and bank holidays in various countries, supports holiday check queries, and computes working days.

supportedIntents.description: Queries requesting list of holidays for a country, checks for holidays on a specific date, or lists holidays for a specific month.
example: Is July 4 a holiday in USA 2026
Is December 25 a holiday in UK 2026
Holidays in the US next month

month.description: Name or index of the month.

schema.description: Main query object defining the holiday request.

type.description: Kind of request: 'list' to retrieve holidays or 'query' for filtered data.

filters.description: Filters to narrow down holidays by country, year, month, or date.
